scope.events: No event stream is mounted by these eight operations.

authorization.availability: Connections must be enabled for the account. Other accounts and disabled servers receive 404 not_found. Google must separately allow the person to connect while verification is pending.
authorization.projects: Source routes use the account's own projects. Shared editors/viewers receive 403 project_role; nonmembers or removed members receive 404.
authorization.grants: Stored metadata is not a live permission check. Attach and Drive reads use the caller's own refreshed grant; read-only tools also check granted scopes and policy.

scenarios: All API fixture responses validate against the published schema

Cross-account and shared-editor source refusal, then membership removal
Duplicate attach keeps original metadata after Drive rename
Project source limit and disconnect keeps sources
Detach works without a live grant; repeat returns 404
Text/Sheets tools and missing scopes without inference
Two Drive pages, search ignores page, oversized page token is ignored
Forbidden, missing, unavailable and unauthorized Drive responses
Created projects and sources are deleted
